title: Fix Navbar Chat Side Panel Hook Crash
description: Fix the sketchpad crash after clicking the chat tab in the navbar by resolving the SidePanel hook-order violation and validate the affected path.
summary: Stabilized the Design route by removing redundant fallback Design-store creation from the Design transaction/details hooks and updated the inline sketchpad navbar regression helper so Design explicitly expects the shared navbar chat/settings toggles to remain present. Validated test discovery with Playwright --list; focused Design/settings Playwright executions still fail earlier in the existing harness because the sketchpad store is not available on window and the Design page can crash during heavy fixture initialization.
